reason: Crexendo sells hosted business phone service (UCaaS), contact center and collaboration software, mainly to SMBs and through white-label channel partners. DigitalOcean rents cloud infrastructure (servers, GPUs, databases) and AI inference/agent platforms to developers and startups. The products are different: communications applications versus infrastructure and AI compute. The buyers are different too: businesses buying phone service versus developers building applications. Both are cloud-delivered and recurring or usage billed, but that is only generic cloud wording.
